candidates.change_summary: Replace return true with return false so the call still completes but returns a different boolean value.
Replace the require(msg.sender == ...) condition with a different address so that calls from the original sender revert but another address can proceed.
Delete the require(msg.sender == ...) statement so that any caller can invoke transfer.
Replace the `require(_tos.length > 0)` condition with `require(_tos.length == 0)` so that calls with non-empty arrays revert.
Delete the `require(_tos.length > 0)` statement so that empty arrays no longer revert and return true.
Replace the return value `true` with `false` so that the function signals failure even though the external calls may have occurred.
